scientific_integrity: The known uncapped moment obstruction is prior and not claimed as new. Strong order-one is mathematically proved for exact normalization; independent validation has not been conducted.
scientific_limitations: Exact Gaussian normalization assumed; quadrature approximations may break exact martingale preservation; one specific scalar driftless diffusion only; no claim of large-step uniform stability. Classical equivalent normalizers remain a residual originality risk.
title: A normalized capped exponential Milstein method preserving positivity, martingales, and all coarse-step moments
